<div class="card-body">
'''You're All Clear Kid!''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊邪魔者は片づいたぞ！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「先頭機は任せろ」をキャンセルする（「感知」の影響を受けない）。2：1フォースを消費して、「デス・スター：トレンチ」上の任意のタイを1機「デス・スター」星系カードに移動させる（フォースは消費しない）。加えて、先頭機を本来の搭乗者が操縦しているなら、「アタック・ラン」の合計値に1を加えることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Youre-All-Clear-Kid-PSA-156625027.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「さあ、さっさとこのデカブツを吹っ飛ばして、基地に帰ろうぜ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The obstruction is cleared!

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Cancel I'm On The Leader (not affected by Sense).

2: Use 1 Force to move one TIE at Death Star: Trench to the Death Star system card (it moves for free). Also, if the lead starfighter is piloted by its matching pilot, you may add 1 to the total of Attack Run.

'''Lore:'''
“Come on, blow this big thing already and let's go back to base!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 邪魔者は片づいたぞ！ (the obstruction is cleared). The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[You're All Clear Kid!]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
